title: Too tightly rolled
text:
Too tightly rolled. So....I couldn't use this yet because it was too tightly rolled up. I now have to train it to be flat as the edges keep curling treating to kill everyone as they trip on said rolled edges.
Its very pretty though so fingers crossed for next year!
